{{short description|Legislative district of the Philippines}} {{Infobox constituency | name = Palawan's 1st congressional district | parl_name = [[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] | image = Ph fil congress palawan 1d.png | caption = Boundary of Palawan's 1st congressional district in [[Palawan]] | image2 = Palawan in Philippines.svg | caption2 = Location of Palawan within the [[Philippines]] | district_label = Province | district = [[Palawan]] | region_label = Region | region = [[Mimaropa]] | population = 462,089 (2020){{PH census|2020}} | electorate = 302,220 (2025){{cite web |title=Data on the Total Number Established and Clustered Precincts, Registered Voters and Voting Centers |url=https://comelec.gov.ph/php-tpls-attachments/2025NLE/Statistics/CONSOLIDATED_2025_Number_Of_Registered_Voters.pdf |website=Commission on Elections|accessdate=May 17, 2025}} | area = {{convert|7725.90|sqkm|sqmi|abbr=on}} | towns = {{Collapsible list | titlestyle = font-weight:normal;text-align:left;background-color:WhiteSmoke; | title = 15 [[Local government in the Philippines|LGU]]s | '''Municipalities''' | [[Agutaya]] | [[Araceli, Palawan|Araceli]] | [[Busuanga]] | [[Cagayancillo]] | [[Coron, Palawan|Coron]] | [[Culion]] | [[Cuyo, Palawan|Cuyo]] | [[Dumaran]] | [[El Nido, Palawan|El Nido]] | [[Kalayaan, Palawan|Kalayaan]] | [[Linapacan]] | [[Magsaysay, Palawan|Magsaysay]] | [[Roxas, Palawan|Roxas]] | [[San Vicente, Palawan|San Vicente]] | [[Taytay, Palawan|Taytay]] }} | year = 1987 | members_label = Representative | members = [[Rose Salvame]] | blank1_name = Political party | blank1_info = {{Color box|{{party color|National Unity Party (Philippines)}}|border=darkgray}} [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|NUP]] | blank2_name = Congressional bloc | blank2_info = Majority }} '''Palawan's 1st congressional district''' is one of the three [[congressional districts of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Palawan]]. It has been represented in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] since 1987.{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 16, 2021}} The district encompasses the northern portion of [[Palawan Island]] including the [[Calamian Islands|Calamianes]], [[Cuyo Archipelago|Cuyo]] and [[Kalayaan, Palawan|Kalayaan]] island (Spartly Islands) chains. It consists of the municipalities of [[Agutaya]], [[Araceli, Palawan|Araceli]], [[Busuanga]], [[Cagayancillo]], [[Coron, Palawan|Coron]], [[Culion]], [[Cuyo, Palawan|Cuyo]], [[Dumaran]], [[El Nido, Palawan|El Nido]], [[Kalayaan, Palawan|Kalayaan]], [[Linapacan]], [[Magsaysay, Palawan|Magsaysay]], [[Roxas, Palawan|Roxas]], [[San Vicente, Palawan|San Vicente]] and [[Taytay, Palawan|Taytay]].{{cite web|url=https://www.chanrobles.com/ordinance.htm |title=The 1987 Constitution of the Republic of the Philippines |publisher=Chan Robles Virtual Law Library |accessdate=February 16, 2021}} The district is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Rose Salvame]] of the [[National Unity Party (Philippines)|National Unity Party]] (NUP).{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=February 16, 2021}} ==Representation history== {| class=wikitable |- ! rowspan="2" | # ! rowspan="2" colspan=2 | Image ! rowspan="2" | Member ! colspan=2 | Term of office ! rowspan="2" | Congress ! rowspan="2" | Party ! rowspan="2" | Electoral history ! rowspan="2" | Constituent
